page.overview:
What is Frontier Access?

The Frontier Access is a small passage connecting Route 40 to the Johto Battle Frontier.

Located to the west of Olivine City, the Frontier Access immediately connects Route 40 to the Battle Frontier. It is a small town situated as a staging area for challengers to the Battle Frontier, much like the Fight Area. It also features different prize redemption shops where Battle Points can be used.

In Generation IV, the Move Tutor is located here. It has 51 different moves to be tutored.

"A place where people from all over come to show off their strength."
